notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
Hello Thieves and Guardians! 🏰💰

Welcome back! Since the last Devlog, we've encountered many challenges and have been working hard to overcome them. We've begun testing our game and have fixed many bugs based on these tests.

✅ What’s New? 


 Stealable items have been placed all around the map.

 We’ve upgraded the lighting and added extra lights for dynamic (non-static) objects.

 We don't want thieves to memorize item locations, so stealable objects now spawn randomly in balanced spots across the map.

 We fixed bugs in the Guardian's animations.

 Crouching has been added to the game.

 The in-game UI design is almost finished. (We’re making small tweaks based on testing.)

 Our musicians have added a brand-new soundtrack to the game.

 Exit doors have been added so thieves can escape after stealing, and their animations are complete.



⚒️ What Are We Working On? 


 NPCs that thieves can blend in with are being placed around the map.

 We’re developing AI so NPCs can walk around and find their own paths.

 We’re fixing a critical multiplayer bug that we encountered during testing.

 Special emotes that allow NPCs to interact with each other are being created.



⌛ What’s Next? 


 Adding roles to the game

 Special emotes for players

 Night mode for the palace map

 Win/Loss screens



That’s all we have to share for now! If you’d like to see some of these updates in action, check out our latest Devlog on Instagram.

🤝 We Value Your Feedback!

Your ideas, suggestions, and comments are incredibly important to us! If you have any mechanics you'd like to see added or aspects you think should be improved, let us know.

📢 [Join Our Discord Server] – Share your feedback and participate in the testing phase!
📢 [Follow Us on Social Media] – Stay up to date with the latest developments!

See you in the next Devlog! 🎮

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hello Thieves and Guardians! 🏰💰

Greetings again! We've been hard at work since our last Devlog, and we decided that now is the right time to bring you an update with our second development log! Here’s what we’ve been working on:

✅ What’s New? 


 We are continuing to improve our first map, the Palace. A new Cellar room has been added.

 The lighting in the map has been reworked, with smoother color transitions and major optimizations.

 The number of interactive objects in the map has increased, and stealable items have been placed.

 Escape hatches have been added to specific locations on the map. (Details will be revealed later!) In certain situations, these hatches will activate, giving thieves an additional escape route.

 Animations for interactive objects such as doors, chests, cabinets, and drawers have been adjusted and placed in the map.

 Extra doors have been added to rooms to improve game flow. Now, every room (except the Treasure Room) has two entry/exit points.

 An NPC named "Lavuk The Smuggler" has been added, where players can sell stolen items.

 Character animations have been improved.

 Sound effects have been updated.

 Main menu and lobby scenes have been set up, with further improvements ongoing.

 Multiplayer infrastructure has been strengthened to ensure a smoother experience.



⚒️ What Are We Working On? 


 Placing stealable items in all rooms of the map.

 Adding a dungeon to the map to increase variety.

 UI improvements for the game.

 Working on a crouch animation, allowing thieves to hide while crouching.

 Exploring new optimization techniques.

 Designing new roles that won’t disrupt game balance.



⌛ What’s Next? 


 Adding floating leaves and environmental effects to enhance immersion—but we’re evaluating their impact on optimization.

 Developing a trade mechanic with an angel for players who trust their luck.

 Implementing a sabotage mechanic to prevent thieves from being camped by the guardian.

 Connecting the escape hatch system with in-game mechanics.



That’s all we have to share for now! If you’d like to see some of these updates in action, check out our latest Devlog on Instagram.

🤝 We Value Your Feedback!

Your ideas, suggestions, and comments are incredibly important to us! If you have any mechanics you'd like to see added or aspects you think should be improved, let us know.

See you in the next Devlog! 🎮

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hello Thieves and Guards! 🏰💰

Greetings! We are Doin' Together Games, and we’re excited to share our first Devlog about our 1v4 multiplayer thief-vs-guard themed game currently in development.

In this devlog series, we’ll discuss the development process, new mechanics, challenges we face, and future plans. In this first entry, we’ll go over the core gameplay mechanics and recent updates.

🎯 Game Concept

Our game features a battle between 4 thieves and 1 guard. The thieves’ goal is to steal a certain amount of gold from the palace and escape, while the guard’s duty is to identify and stop them. Thieves can disguise themselves as NPCs to blend in and move unnoticed. The guard, on the other hand, must observe suspicious behavior to detect real players.

Here are the core mechanics:

Disguise System: Thieves can take on the appearance of random NPCs within the palace.

Stealing Mechanic: Gold and valuable items is scattered in certain locations, and thieves must steal it within a time limit.

Guard Abilities: The guard can attack suspected players or use special abilities to expose them.

Now, let's go over the features we’ve developed so far and the challenges we’ve encountered.

🛠️ Recent Developments and Challenges

✅ Completed Features


 The disguise system is now fully functional. Thieves can successfully transform into a random NPC.

 The guard’s attack mechanics have been implemented. The guard can now strike suspected players to reveal them.

 Palace interior design is mostly complete. Visual enhancements and interactive objects have been added.


⚠️ Ongoing Issues and Work in Progress


 Disguise system bugs: Occasionally, thieves transform into incorrect NPC models or experience animation glitches.

 AI behavior inconsistencies: Sometimes, the guard struggles to differentiate NPCs from players. We are working on making NPC movements more natural.
 
 Multiplayer synchronization issues: Some players see others in different positions due to minor network desync problems. We are optimizing to resolve these.

 Both player and interactable object animation systems are almost done. We're working on some little details.

⏭️ What's Coming Next?


 Stabilizing the multiplayer system (Optimizations are ongoing to ensure a smoother experience.)
 
 Adding special abilities for thieves (e.g., temporary invisibility or distraction moves.)
 
 Enhancing the guard’s detection system (New mechanics will help the guard analyze suspicious behavior more effectively.)

 Interactive objects in the palace (Lockable doors, secret passages, etc.)


🤝 We Value Your Feedback!

Your ideas, suggestions, and comments are extremely important to us! If you have any mechanics you’d like to see added or improvements to suggest, let us know.

📢 [Join Our Discord] – Share your feedback and participate in testing!
📢 [Follow Our Social Media] – Stay updated on our latest developments!

See you in the next devlog! 🎮
